baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word-1 nominal from ء ف ك is followed by the word-2 causative verb from ه و ي.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first root supplies an entity already turned away from its proper orientation; the second supplies imposed dropping and casting. The clause therefore has two material stages: inversion, then forced descent.

activation_trace.role: Turning a thing away from its proper direction supplies the entity's prior inversion.
Falling into an abyss supplies the vertical result of the overthrow.
Casting an object from above supplies active causation rather than spontaneous collapse.

changed_reading.after: An already direction-reversed entity was actively hurled downward; inversion and descent are distinct operations.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same two focus roots also carry falsehood, diverted judgment, and self-inclination branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The nominal can characterize an order whose truth and judgment have been turned aside, while the verb can retain the pressure of inclination. A physical overthrow and an inwardly misdirected order coexist rather than excluding one another.

activation_trace.role: A lie diverted from truth supplies the focus entity's falsehood-bearing character.
Turned judgment and lost resolve supply an internal failure of orientation.
Desire and self-inclination supply the inward vector that parallels outward descent.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports only a physical catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: It can also portray the collapse of an entity organized by diverted truth, impaired judgment, and inclination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventories connect the word-1 root to rain-deprived land and the word-2 root to void, hollowing, and descent.
baseline_models.mechanism: The overthrow can be carried as habitat unmaking: productive ground is turned into a barren, hollowed space, with the downward casting as the transition into that state.

activation_trace.role: Land from which rain and growth are diverted supplies the barren endpoint.
Air, void, and hollowness supply the emptied condition of the ruined habitat.
Descent into an abyss supplies the material transition from inhabited ground to void.

changed_reading.after: A habitable surface was converted into rainless emptiness, with descent functioning as ecological unmaking.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, ه و ي first names physical falling, then denied speech from desire, then what selves desire, and finally causative casting in the focus. The focus becomes a semantic hinge where inward inclination and outward descent converge around an entity already diverted from truth.

activation_trace.role: The opening occurrence activates literal falling into a depth as the surah's first motion.
The desire branch makes inward inclination the explicitly rejected source of speech.
The later occurrence assigns desire to selves and supplies the live inward vector.
Falsehood diverted from truth gives the falling entity an epistemically inverted character.
Casting an object makes the final recurrence an imposed outward trajectory.

structural_cues: Packet order places ه و ي at 53:1, 53:3, 53:23, and 53:53, moving from fall to desire to causative overthrow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root and its fall/desire/casting branches; I infer that desire-driven diversion is made outwardly visible as descent. A live alternative is lexical cohesion without a causal moral arrow.

changed_reading.before: The desire occurrences and the focus catastrophe are separate senses of one root.
changed_reading.after: The focus makes the earlier inward inclination legible as an outward fall, while preserving literal casting as a complete reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early vision sequence combines straight completion, descent from above, and non-deviation, and 53:42 names an endpoint. The focus recombines the same spatial grammar negatively: direction is inverted and descent terminates in an abyss.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and completion establish the positive orientation against which inversion can be read.
Hanging or descending from a height supplies a controlled vertical movement rather than collapse.
Deviation from straightness, explicitly negated there, supplies the axis that the focus inversion violates.
The endpoint reached by a thing supplies a bounded destination for the surah's vertical motions.
Turning away from the proper direction supplies the negative counterpart to straight completion.
A fall into an abyss supplies uncontrolled terminal descent.

structural_cues: The 53:6-17 sequence moves through straightening, an upper horizon, descent, nearness, and a gaze that does not deviate; the focus later reverses that geometry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two vertical sequences and explicit straight/deviate/invert branches; I read the later fall as a negative counterpart to the earlier controlled descent. They may instead be independent scenes sharing only spatial vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an isolated downward catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: It is the surah's inverted descent: unlike the earlier movement that preserves orientation and reaches its endpoint, this entity loses direction and plunges.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context opposes truthful perception to following conjecture and opposes straying to guidance on a path. Those relations make the focus roots' falsehood, directional inversion, and fall into a material rendering of failed epistemic navigation.

activation_trace.role: The opposite of truth, negated in the perception scene, establishes a truthfulness test.
Following behind supplies the mechanism by which conjecture becomes a chosen route.
Doubt and imagining supply the unreliable object being followed.
Gentle direction toward road and truth supplies the rejected positive orientation.
Straying from guidance and intended direction supplies the diagnosis of failed navigation.
An extended traveled road turns epistemic orientation into an explicit path model.
A lie diverted from truth supplies the focus entity's epistemic reversal.
Falling into a depth materializes the terminal consequence of losing the path.

structural_cues: Negated lying in 53:11 precedes the conjecture/desire versus guidance contrast in 53:23-28 and the stray/path/guided classification in 53:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a coherent truth-following-path field and focus branches of falsehood, inversion, and falling; I infer a spatial enactment of epistemic failure. The live alternative is analogy rather than a claim that the catastrophe is caused by one cognitive error.

changed_reading.before: The focus names a destroyed entity with no relation to the surah's argument about knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Its physical inversion becomes the terminal image of a route built from conjecture and diverted truth, without ceasing to be physical destruction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately around the focus, wrongdoing can image putting a thing out of its place, transgression can image crossing a limit or overflowing, and covering completes the event. Ethical excess is thus rendered as a material choreography of displacement, plunge, and burial.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in the wrong time or physical place supplies material dislocation before the focus.
Crossing the limit in rebellion supplies the boundary breach that precedes collapse.
Rising water and sweeping force give excess a concrete destructive motion.
Directional reversal turns prior wrong placement into the focus entity's physical condition.
Casting a thing down supplies the imposed plunge after dislocation.
A cover rising over and concealing a thing supplies the event's burial-like completion.

structural_cues: The superlatives in 53:52, the object-first causative clause in 53:53, and the repeated feminine object in 53:54 form an uninterrupted sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent branches of wrong placement, exceeded limit, sweeping force, inversion, casting, and covering; I infer that moral disorder is made materially visible. The alternative is a list of descriptors and effects without symbolic conversion between them.

changed_reading.before: Wrongdoing and the physical overthrow are merely adjacent facts.
changed_reading.after: The focus converts being out of place and beyond bounds into literal dislocation: the entity is reversed, plunged, and covered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding chain repeatedly attributes causative acts to one agent, then specifies destruction and absence of remainder; the following verse continues with covering of the same feminine object. This grammar sharpens أَهْوَىٰ as deliberate casting within a sequence of operations, not an intransitive fall.

activation_trace.role: Falling into destruction and annihilation supplies the category of the surrounding causative act.
What remains of a thing, explicitly negated in sequence, supplies the completeness of removal.
Casting an object from above resolves the focus verb as an agentive operation in the chain.
An encompassing cover supplies the next operation performed upon the same feminine object.

structural_cues: Repeated causatives attributed through وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ in 53:43-50 lead into destruction examples; 53:53 fronts the feminine object, and 53:54 resumes it with a feminine pronoun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the causative chain, object continuity, and casting/covering branches; I infer continuity of agent through the focus. A syntactic boundary could loosen the chain, but it would not erase the causative casting image in أَهْوَىٰ.

changed_reading.before: The entity collapsed or fell on its own.
changed_reading.after: It is selected as the object of a staged act: the agent casts it down and then lets an encompassing cover finish the destruction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remote branches inside the same packet oppose sheltered garden and fertile earth to cessation of rain and rainless land. The focus independently repeats rain deprivation and void, allowing the catastrophe to be carried as the unmaking of an ecosystem as well as a built place.

activation_trace.role: Cloud clearing and rain ceasing supply the first drought-oriented context image.
A garden sheltered by trees supplies the positive habitat pole.
Soft, fertile earth supplies productive ground before its imagined reversal.
A land with no rain places ecological barrenness inside the nearby destruction vocabulary.
Rain-deprived, growthless land anchors the ecological reading directly in the focus nominal.
Void and hollowness supply the loss of inhabited and vegetated fullness.

structural_cues: Garden and origin-from-earth images occur before the destruction list, while rainless-land branches recur at 53:50 and in the focus inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile, sheltered, rain-stopped, rainless, and void images; I infer an ecological state change across those branches. The alternative is branch coincidence with no intended habitat-level mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus destroys an entity but leaves its material aftermath unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The casting reverses a habitat: shelter and fertile ground become rain-deprived, growthless void.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a wind-course image and rapid travel are branch-distant from the focus nominal's ordinary entity reading. It remains valid as a focus-anchored material analogy using both exact roots; downstream prose should describe altered trajectories and storm-like hurling, not identify the singular nominal itself as a wind.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 has a branch of winds diverted from their courses, and word 2 has rapid thrown motion plus casting.

activation_trace.role: Winds turning from their usual courses supply a catastrophe of altered trajectories.
Rapid going and thrown bodies in motion supply storm-like acceleration.
Casting a thing down keeps the altered-course image attached to the focus event.

changed_reading.before: The entity is statically overturned and then dropped.
changed_reading.after: Its overthrow can be imagined dynamically as a course-swerving, rapidly hurled event, with storm mechanics as analogy rather than referent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the 53:23 source is ه د ي and the demolition and steep-descent images belong to the packet's non-dominant split mapped target. The packet explicitly authorizes that target and the images visibly converge with focus inversion and falling; downstream prose must call this a split-root branch echo, never a lexical claim that guidance means demolition or that it alone causes the event.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's directional reversal and abyssal fall align with demolition and steep-descent images exposed under the split context mapping.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and demolition supply a non-dominant split-root echo of the focus catastrophe.
A difficult downward slope supplies the split target's spatial convergence with the focus fall.
Directional reversal anchors the demolition echo in the focus entity.
Falling into an abyss anchors the steep-descent echo in the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: The arrival of guidance and the later overthrow have no branch-level contact.
changed_reading.after: A qualified split-root echo lets rejected orientation cast a shadow of demolition and steep descent ahead of the focus event.

strongest_changes: The repeated ه و ي sequence makes the focus converge desire, physical fall, and causative casting.
The causative and pronominal sequence around 53:50-54 changes spontaneous collapse into a staged agentive overthrow.
Immediate branches of wrong placement, exceeded limits, inversion, descent, and covering turn moral disorder into material choreography.
The earlier straight, controlled descent becomes a spatial counter-model to the focus's inverted plunge.
summary.what_was_special: Two compact focus roots support several coexisting mechanisms: physical inversion, epistemic diversion, desire becoming trajectory, habitat voiding, and altered-course motion. Same-root recurrence, adjacent causative grammar, and a non-dominant split mapping each activate a different changed reading without forcing a single synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet roots alone do not settle the historical identity or material composition of the feminine focus nominal.
The desire-to-fall and moral-to-material arrows may be designed semantic convergence or reader-supplied analogy.
The ecological, storm, and split-guidance readings should remain explicitly exploratory branch resonances.
